title: Derived ambient pullback associativity and unit laws
statement: For every base scheme K and coefficient exponent s, the three derived associativity and unit equations for the specified ambient pullback comparisons hold for Derived.

source.place: Tags 015F and 04VG; exact termwise functors and localization universal property

proof.text: Take the three ordinary pullback laws over K from ordinary_pullback_compositionLaws, retaining all structure maps and finiteness hypotheses.

For associativity, postcompose the ordinary comparison for (w composed with f, g) with the equality isomorphism induced by Category.assoc. Apply the proved source-library theorem Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompNatIso_cocycle, which passes the ordinary cocycle through exact termwise functors and localization factorizations. Its hypothesis is exactly the ordinary associativity equation.

For each unit, identify the ordinary compositor followed by its endpoint equality isomorphism with the corresponding whiskering of the ordinary identity comparison. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso to that equality. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso under whiskering, its left and right unit laws, and cancellation of invertible components give the two derived unit equations. The private helpers derivedInnerUnit and derivedOuterUnit prove these cancellations in Lean.

Localization preserves postcomposition by a natural isomorphism by mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_trans. Equality induction identifies the localized endpoint equality isomorphism with the equality isomorphism of derivedPull; evaluate its hom component and assemble the three laws.

proof_origin.place: Tags 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor) and 04VG (lemma-properties-left-localization), using the proved exact-localization coherence API in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.MapDerivedCategoryCocycle and MapDerivedCategoryMate.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_pullback_compositionLaws (K : Scheme.{t}) (s : Option ℕ) :
    (∀ {W X Y Z : Scheme.{t}} (w : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
      (aW : W ⟶ K) (aX : X ⟶ K) (aY : Y ⟶ K) (aZ : Z ⟶ K)
      [LocallyOfFiniteType aW] [QuasiCompact aW] [LocallyOfFiniteType aX]
      [QuasiCompact aX] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType aZ] [QuasiCompact aZ]
      (_hw : w ≫ aX = aW) (_hf : f ≫ aY = aX) (_hg : g ≫ aZ = aY)
      (M : Derived ell E Z s),
      (derivedPull ell E w s).map ((derivedComp ell E f g s).hom.app M) ≫
          (derivedComp ell E w (f ≫ g) s).hom.app M =
        (derivedComp ell E w f s).hom.app ((derivedPull ell E g s).obj M) ≫
          (derivedComp ell E (w ≫ f) g s).hom.app M ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun a ↦ (derivedPull ell E a s).obj M)
            (Category.assoc w f g))) ∧
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (aX : X ⟶ K) (aY : Y ⟶ K)
      [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
      (_hf : f ≫ aY = aX) (M : Derived ell E Y s),
      (derivedPull ell E f s).map ((derivedIdentity ell E Y s).hom.app M) =
        (derivedComp ell E f (𝟙 Y) s).hom.app M ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun a ↦ (derivedPull ell E a s).obj M)
            (Category.comp_id f))) ∧
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (aX : X ⟶ K) (aY : Y ⟶ K)
      [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
      (_hf : f ≫ aY = aX) (M : Derived ell E Y s),
      (derivedIdentity ell E X s).hom.app ((derivedPull ell E f s).obj M) =
        (derivedComp ell E (𝟙 X) f s).hom.app M ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun a ↦ (derivedPull ell E a s).obj M)
            (Category.id_comp f)))
